  "two_by_two": null,
  "sensitivity": null,
  "specificity": null,
  "ppv": null,
  "npv": null,
  "endpoints_animal": [
    "death"
  ],
  "endpoints_human": [
    "death"
  ],
  "endpoint_class": "primary-hard",
  "concordance_definition": "The study aimed to predict the effect size and establish an ethical basis for exposing high-risk patients to a novel therapy by quantitatively summarizing the results of all preclinical studies of MSC therapy for in vivo animal models of sepsis.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "None of the experiments were considered low risk of bias across all six domains of methodological quality.",
    "Paucity of studies that adequately implemented and reported internal validity practices precluded an evaluation of their effects on effect size.",
    "Few studies were included in certain subgroup analyses (e.g., autologous cells, multiple doses, intraperitoneal administration, and adipose tissue source), and results of one study with differing results may have skewed data.",
    "The ability of one study to heavily influence overall effect estimates is a short-coming of meta-analyses that include few studies.",
    "Potential effect of publication bias (i.e., bias due to the publication of only positive studies).",
    "Trim and fill analysis indicated that a number of unpublished negative studies may exist.",
    "Inability to analyze potential unpublished studies may have led to an overstatement of effect size.",
    "Only two studies incorporated a majority of elements addressing construct validity, thus the effect of construct validity on MSC therapy of sepsis remains to be determined.",
    "Variably reported characterization of cell products.",
    "Dosing of cell products was not equivalent between species, even after adjusting for total cells given.",
    "Severity of disease in animal models at the time of MSC administration is unclear.",
    "Lack of transparent reporting of risk of bias elements that minimize the ability to evaluate threats to validity.",
    "None of the included studies were considered low risk of bias across all domains.",
    "Construct validity was highly variable.",
    "It is unclear what the influence of these methodological limitations might be in this particular study due to our inability to perform meaningful subgroup analyses.",
    "Evaluation of methodological aspects of included studies relied on what the authors reported, and this may have been incomplete in cases.",
    "Failure to address threats to internal validity likely contributes to an exaggerated effect size."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "3114 records were yielded from the systematic search.",
    "18 studies were included in the review.",
    "980 animals were involved in total across the 18 studies.",
    "Studies were published over a six year period (2009 to 2015).",
    "80% of experiments used mice.",
    "50% of experiments used cecal-ligation and puncture to establish sepsis.",
    "40% of experiments used bacterial component injection to establish sepsis.",
    "10% of experiments used live bacterial injection to establish sepsis.",
    "60% of MSCs were derived from bone marrow.",
    "20% of MSCs were derived from adipose tissue.",
    "20% of MSCs were derived from umbilical cord.",
    "50% of MSCs were xenogenic.",
    "40% of MSCs were syngeneic.",
    "5% of MSCs were allogeneic.",
    "5% of MSCs were autologous.",
    "90% of studies administered cells as a single dose.",
    "80% of studies administered cells intravenously.",
    "20% of studies administered cells intraperitoneally.",
    "MSC therapy was initiated between 0 to 6 hr after experimental induction of the disease state.",
    "MSC therapy in preclinical models of sepsis significantly reduced the overall odds of death (odds ratio (OR) 0.27, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.18–0.40).",
    "I 2 statistic demonstrated a low degree of heterogeneity across studies (I 2 = 33%).",
    "Reduction in mortality was maintained regardless of when death occurred: before two days (OR 0.31, 95% CI 0.21–0.46), between two and four days (OR 0.20, 95% CI 0.11–0.38), or more than four days (OR 0.18, 95% CI 0.11–0.32).",
    "Intravenous administration of MSCs demonstrated efficacy (OR 0.28, 95% CI 0.20–0.40).",
    "Intraperitoneal administration of MSCs did not have a statistically significant effect (OR 0.21, 95% CI 0.02–1.89) and had high heterogeneity (I 2 = 78%).",
    "Significant effects were seen using MSCs derived from bone marrow (OR 0.13, 95% CI 0.05–0.35).",
    "Significant effects were seen using MSCs derived from umbilical cord (OR 0.30, 95% CI 0.21–0.43).",
    "MSCs derived from adipose tissue did not demonstrate statistically significant efficacy (OR 0.35, 95% CI 0.03–4.39, I 2 = 79%).",
    "MSCs administered to mice were effective (OR 0.23, 95% CI 0.15–0.36).",
    "MSC administration to rats did not produce a statistically significant effect (OR 0.47, 95% CI 0.18–1.21).",
    "45% of experiments reported that the animals were randomized.",
    "None of the experiments described methods of sequence generation or how allocation concealment was achieved.",
    "No studies described blinding of personnel performing the experiments.",
    "One study did not blind assessors for the outcome of mortality.",
    "10% of studies had a high risk of bias for incomplete outcome data.",
    "65% of experiments had unclear risk of bias for incomplete outcome data.",
    "No studies reported an appropriate rationale for selection of sample size.",
    "Two experiments (10%) used animals with comorbidities.",
    "40% of experiments used adult animal models.",
    "50% used infectious models of sepsis.",
    "90% of studies initiated MSC therapy after the induction of the disease.",
    "Two studies incorporated a majority of construct validity elements (i.e. at least five of eight elements).",
    "Effect size between studies incorporating a majority of construct validity elements (OR 0.18, 95% CI 0.08–0.42) and those incorporating fewer elements (OR 0.28, 95% CI 0.17–0.44) showed no difference.",
    "50% of experiments demonstrated statistically significant beneficial effects of MSCs.",
    "Median sample size was 19 animals per group for experiments with statistically significant beneficial effects.",
    "Egger regression indicated publication bias (p=0.019).",
    "Post-hoc trim and fill analysis suggested a relative overestimation of effect size of 27%.",
    "MSCs remained associated with a statistically significant reduction in mortality after adjustment (OR 0.34, 95% CI 0.22–0.52).",
    "Three clinical trials have been initiated following a systematic review and meta-analysis of animal data.",
    "Approximately 20-30% 90-day mortality rate in human septic shock patients."
  ]
}
